content: At the document level, a bi-directional recurrent neural network BIBREF20 is often used to encode all the sentences sequentially forward and backward, with such model achieving remarkable success in machine translation BIBREF21 . As units, we selected gated recurrent units (GRU) BIBREF22 , in light of favorable results shown in BIBREF23 . The GRU is represented with the standard reset, update, and new gates.
